title: ChatGPT and ACP: the 2025 Instant Checkout model versus the 2026 discovery-first model
caption: In 2025 ChatGPT ran the full ACP checkout in chat. On 2026-03-24 OpenAI let merchants use their own checkout and extended ACP to product feeds and discovery. The 'moving to apps' quote is reported only, and no primary source gives a shutdown date.
alt: Two panels. 2025 model: buyer in ChatGPT, ChatGPT runs ACP create, update and complete, a Delegate Payment token such as a Stripe SPT, and the merchant charges as merchant of record. 2026 model: the merchant pushes product feeds through ACP directly or through providers, the buyer discovers in ChatGPT, then checks out on the merchant site (generally available) or, for select partners, through the payment sheet in apps (private beta). An arrow labeled scaled back 2026-03-24 joins the panels.

sourceOfTruth.label: OpenAI, Powering product discovery in ChatGPT (2026-03-24)
